integrity: Finite exact arithmetic corroboration and independent geometric sampling accompany an explicit all-N analytic proof; reproducible checker included.
scientific_limitations: Area expectation for N>=3 arclength-uniform boundary samples of nondegenerate Euclidean triangles; normalized by original triangle area, not a full area law or fixed-perimeter unnormalized extremum. Infimum belongs only to geometric degeneration. Published equivalent work not ruled out; independent validation has not been performed.
title: Exact finite-sample area and sharp shape order for boundary-random triangles
